review_contract.purpose: Migration-time semantic ownership seed. Not a production source selector, a replacement renderer or proof of independent feature combinations.
review_contract.paths: All file paths are repository-relative; no machine-specific paths are persisted.
review_contract.witnesses: Expand witness_groups and witness_anchor_groups through their exact context_set references to exactly the twenty named context_commits. Missing or duplicate contexts, missing raw objects, raw SHA256 mismatch, changed line ranges or changed anchors invalidate this review.
review_contract.hunks: Primary zero-context ranges use git diff --unified=0 with the two exact primary commits. start/count are Git line coordinates (one-based when count>0; insertion/deletion boundaries when count=0). SHA256 is over the exact UTF-8 bytes of that line slice, preserving CRLF and EOF without newline. Zero-count slices use the empty SHA256.
review_contract.member_anchors: primary_dev_lines are inclusive and bind to the exact raw dev/1.19.2 blob, not moving working-tree sources. witness_anchor_groups record structural anchor occurrence lines, not whether a feature is enabled. An anchor may remain in an off/release member.
review_contract.hunk_owners: A multiple-owner hunk is a required split, not an any-owner catchall. member_region_ids and explicit token maps explain the split. imports-or-surrounding-syntax means syntax must follow the declared consumer owner, not a broad tree selector.
review_contract.independent_combinations: All release/off witnesses and witnessed dev combinations need exact reconstruction. Unsupported partial combinations remain blocked until owner-specific imports, grammar/AST APIs, resource/dependency effects and tests close their graphs.
review_contract.no_implicit_environment_flag: Functional flags may use only their own reviewed IDs. minecraft_version drives API/released-behavior alternatives. environment, preset, projection key, snapshots and source hashes are not feature owners.
review_contract.normalization: No raw witness normalization performed here. Existing Java newline normalization approvals elsewhere do not authorize changes to these mixed sources.
review_contract.future_ledger_conversion: Before rendering these assignments, obtain RegionReviewReport fingerprints from actual consolidator inputs, explicitly split ambiguous subregions, record decisions and prove reconstruction. This document is not an already serialized RegionOwnershipDecision artifact.
